clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Gornek hands aspiring orc shamans a message from Shikrik. It calls them to become spiritual leaders and conduits for elemental spirits.

New orc shamans begin training under veteran overseers in the Valley of Trials. While an initiate performs initial trials for Gornek, he hands them a rune-covered document sent by Shikrik, the local shamanic instructor. The message summons them to deeper communion with the elements. Among the orcs, shamans mediate between the living and their ancestors. The writ marks a move from brute strength toward disciplined reverence for ancestors.
